metadata.title: David Moore - Let go by Carolina
metadata.description: The Panthers released Moore on Tuesday, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Moore has seen zero offensive snaps in each of his last two outings, and with the Panthers utilizing John Metchie and Brycen Tremayne more as of late, the Panthers opted to move on from Moore on Tuesday. The 2017 seventh-rounder will explore his next options as he looks to join another team in need of wide receiver depth, like as a member of the practice squad.

metadata.title: David Moore released by Panthers
metadata.description: The Panthers released WR David Moore.
metadata.analysis: Moore will figure to seek another opportunity.

metadata.title: Panthers Release Wide Receiver David Moore
metadata.description: Carolina Panthers wide receiver David Moore was released Tuesday after appearing in six games this season. His only catch was a 27-yard gain against Philadelphia in Week 6. Moore played 13 offensive snaps against Tampa Bay the following week, but his only snap in Sunday's loss to Denver came on a 17-yard punt return, his longest of the season. Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker each played at least 80% of Carolina's offensive snaps against the Broncos, with Brycen Tremayne getting 21 snaps and John Metchie III getting 19. Carolina signed Moore from the practice squad on Sept. 30 and listed him as its lead punt and kickoff returner in October. Anthony Tyus III handled all four of Carolina's kickoff returns against Denver for 110 yards and leads the team with 18 kickoff returns for 451 yards. Trevor Etienne gained nine yards on Carolina's other punt return Sunday. The Panthers have been looking to expand his role on special teams, and Etienne already leads the team with seven punt returns to Moore's four.

metadata.title: David Moore - Relegated to special teams
metadata.description: Moore didn't receive any playing time on offense and logged two snaps on special teams in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
metadata.analysis: After logging a season-high 13 snaps on offense a week earlier in the Panthers' blowout loss to the Buccaneers, Moore's playing time was contained to special teams while Carolina leaned exclusively on Tetaiora McMillan, Jalen Coker, Brycen Tremayne and John Metchie at receiver.

metadata.title: David Moore - Inks to active roster
metadata.description: The Panthers signed Moore off the practice squad to the active roster Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: With Xavier Legette (knee) missing last Sunday's loss to the Browns, Moore was elevated from the practice squad for his 2026 debut in Week 3. Now that Jalen Coker (quadriceps) is also dinged up, Moore gets a spot on the 53-man roster after playing five offensive snaps and another 13 on special teams against Cleveland.

metadata.title: David Moore - Reverts to practice squad
metadata.description: Moore reverted to Carolina's practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction report.
metadata.analysis: Moore played just five snaps on offense during Sunday's loss to Cleveland but failed to haul in either of his targets, while seeing the bulk of his playing time come on special teams, returning two punts for 14 yards and three kicks for 39 yards. The 2017 seventh-round pick also managed to record a tackle following a Bryce Young interception.

metadata.title: David Moore - Elevated for Sunday
metadata.description: The Panthers elevated Moore from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against the Browns, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Moore is set to suit up as a depth wide receiver due to the potential absence of starting options Jalen Coker (ankle) and Xavier Legette (knee). If both wide receivers can overcome their injuries and play Sunday, Moore will likely be game-day inactive for the team.

metadata.title: David Moore - Sticking around in Carolina
metadata.description: The Panthers signed Moore to their practice squad Monday, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Moore will stick around in Carolina, albeit on the practice squad, after previously being released by the team. The 31-year-old caught just one pass across four appearances with the Panthers last season. He will likely only be elevated should the team suffer injuries at the position.

metadata.title: David Moore - Logs one catch in HOF Game
metadata.description: Moore caught one pass on two targets for five yards during Carolina's 33-30 win over Arizona in Thursday's Hall of Fame Game.
metadata.analysis: Moore's lone catch came early in the second quarter, and he finished Thursday's game having played 18 total snaps (17 on offense, one on special teams). The 2017 seven-rounder spent most of last year on injured reserve due to a dislocated elbow and appeared in only four regular-season games before being a healthy scratch during the Panthers' NFC wild-card loss against the Rams. Moore is competing against Brycen Tremayne, Casey Washington, Ja'Seem Reed and John Metchie for a depth spot on the Panthers' 53-man roster.

metadata.title: David Moore re-signs with Panthers
metadata.description: The Panthers re-signed WR David Moore.
metadata.analysis: Moore caught one pass last season for Carolina. He will remain in a depth role in the Panthers wide receiver room.

metadata.title: David Moore - Re-signing with Carolina
metadata.description: Moore agreed to terms Tuesday on a contract to remain with the Panthers, Mike Kaye of The Charlotte Observer reports.
metadata.analysis: Moore caught just one pass across four regular-season appearances in 2025. The depth wide receiver will likely reprise his role as an emergency option in 2026. Moore's deal is likely another one-year term around the league minimum, with additional money tied to incentives.

metadata.title: Panthers Re-Sign Receiver David Moore
metadata.description: The Carolina Panthers re-signed wide receiver David Moore to an undisclosed deal on Tuesday, according to Mike Kaye of The Charlotte Observer. Moore only played in four games for the Panthers in 2025 in his second year with the team, catching his only target for five yards. The 31-year-old former seventh-round selection by the Seattle Seahawks in 2017 out of East Central totaled 32 receptions on a career-high 57 targets for 351 yards and three touchdowns in 17 games played in his first year in Carolina in 2024. Moore will return to provide depth for Carolina's wide receiver room, but he can pretty much be ignored in all fantasy formats going into his ninth NFL season. Moore has never gone over 35 receptions, 445 receiving yards, or six touchdowns in a single year in his NFL career.

metadata.title: David Moore - Catches one pass in 2025
metadata.description: Moore caught his lone target for five yards across four regular-season appearances during the 2025 season.
metadata.analysis: After posting a 32-351-3 receiving line on 57 targets across all 17 regular-season contests, including five starts, during the 2024 campaign, Moore was relegated to strict reserve duties this season. Now 31 years old, Moore is scheduled to become an unrestricted free agent next month.

metadata.title: David Moore - Not playing vs. Rams
metadata.description: Moore (coach's decision) is inactive for Carolina's wild-card matchup versus the Rams on Saturday.
metadata.analysis: Moore was just activated off injured reserve earlier in the week after missing time with an elbow injury but will nonetheless be held out of Saturday's game. Tetairoa McMillan, Jalen Coker and Xavier Legette should continue to serve as the team's top receivers against Los Angeles, while Moore will look to suit up next week should the Panthers advance to the divisional round.

metadata.title: David Moore (elbow) activated from IR
metadata.description: The Panthers activated WR David Moore from injured reserve.
metadata.analysis: Moore had been on IR since the end of September. He'll have a chance to return in a depth role for the postseason.
